== Title ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍少佐</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">同じ位置の他の帝国軍（リーダーは除く）は全員、没収値＋１。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">典型的な帝国軍のリーダー。日々、訓練と緊急事態の演習を重ね、部隊の能力を高いレベルに保つ。デイン・ジャー少佐は、その勇気と実行力で知られている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Imperial Commander]].

'''Lore''' — A typical Imperial leader. Daily training and crisis drills keep the unit's ability at a high level. Commander Daine Jir is known for his courage and decisiveness.

'''Game text''' — Each of your other Imperials at the same location (except leaders) is forfeit +1.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
位置 vs site. Lore names デイン・ジャー and says 勇気と実行力, not “bold and outspoken”. Printed stats bar is 戦闘力１ 能力値２. Warrior icon is printed. No uniqueness marker.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-imperialcommander.gif|Original English face]], [[Imperial Commander]].</ref>
